# Bluebonnet Hollow Dental
> Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional Austin, TX practice offering checkups, implants, whitening and same-day emergency care.

This is a fictional demo clinic. It is not a real practice.

Address: 2214 Meridian Park Drive, Suite 110, Austin, TX 78704. Phone: (512) 555-0142. Open Monday through Thursday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., and on Friday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.

## Services
- [Services](https://www.bluebonnethollowdental.example/services): Dental care at Bluebonnet Hollow Dental in Austin, TX: checkups and cleanings, tooth-colored fillings, root canal therapy, dental implants and more.
- [Checkups and cleanings](https://www.bluebonnethollowdental.example/services/cleanings-exams): Routine exams and professional cleanings, with X-rays when they are needed, to keep small problems small.
- [Dental implants](https://www.bluebonnethollowdental.example/services/dental-implants): A post placed in the jawbone replaces a missing tooth root and holds a crown. We start with an exam to see whether it is right for you.
- [Teeth whitening](https://www.bluebonnethollowdental.example/services/teeth-whitening): Supervised in-office whitening, after an exam confirms your mouth is ready and what shade change to expect.
- [Emergency dental care](https://www.bluebonnethollowdental.example/services/emergency-dentist): Same-day emergency visits when we have room in the schedule, and an on-call dentist after hours.
